homeAgency.heading: Capturing velocity, engineering, and trackside atmosphere.
homeAgency.paragraph1: Paddocker is a dedicated motorsport visual agency specializing in high-speed trackside documentation, paddock storytelling, and commercial campaigns for racing teams, constructors, and automotive brands.
homeAgency.paragraph2: From the high-pressure tension of the pit wall to the quiet precision inside the garage, we operate across international circuits to translate kinetic speed and engineering into iconic visual narratives.

aboutIntro.name: Shu Zelin
aboutIntro.shortBio: Motorsport photography trackside and in the paddock.
fullBio: What started as carrying a compact camera on late-night walks evolved into a dedicated pursuit of light, pace, and narrative structure.

Whether tracking high-speed machinery trackside, waiting for a solitary silhouette in an urban canyon, or building digital products by day, my focus remains the same: intentional framing and honest detail.
